title: Pure Grepher
summary: Pure Grepher and Warrior Dai Grepher Chaos swarming build, exploring the wandering swordsman's divergent paths across LIGHT, DARK, and Chaos dimensions. The deck leverages Dark Grepher and Chaos Grepher to rapidly dump and banish opposing Attributes, cheating out iconic bosses like Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning, The Chaos Creator, and Chaos Angel.

summary.title: Starters & Milling
points: Dark Grepher discards a Level 5+ DARK monster (Destrudo or The Chaos Creator) to Special Summon itself from hand, then discards a DARK monster to send any DARK monster from Deck to GY.
Chaos Grepher (treated as both LIGHT and DARK on the field) discards a LIGHT or DARK monster to send a monster of the opposite Attribute from Deck to GY.
Fusion Deployment reveals Ryu Senshi from the Extra Deck to Special Summon Warrior Dai Grepher or Ryu-Kishin Powered directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai summons Warrior Dai Grepher directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Reinforcement of the Army searches any Grepher Warrior: Dark Grepher, Chaos Grepher, Lightray Grepher, or Warrior Dai Grepher.

summary.title: Opening: Dark Grepher + Destrudo
steps: Discard Destrudo the Lost Dragon's Frisson from your hand to Special Summon Dark Grepher.
Activate Dark Grepher's Ignition effect: discard a DARK monster to send Ryu-Kishin Powered (or another DARK target) from your Deck to the GY.
Pay half your LP to target Dark Grepher and Special Summon Destrudo from the GY as a Level 3 Tuner.
Synchro Summon Level 7 F.A. Dawn Dragster (for Spell/Trap negation) or tune with a Level 4 to make Level 10 Chaos Angel.
Banish Destrudo (DARK) and a LIGHT Grepher from your GY to Special Summon Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning or The Chaos Creator.

summary.title: Chaos Payoffs & Fusion Bosses
points: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning banishes 1 monster on the field face-up, or makes a second attack in a row if it destroys a monster by battle.

The Chaos Creator banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY to Special Summon itself, then targets 3 banished monsters (such as cards banished by Lightray Grepher) to Special Summon 1 and return the rest to the Deck.
Chaos Angel treats any LIGHT or DARK monster as a Tuner, banishes a card on summon, and makes your monsters battle-immune (from LIGHT) and unaffected by monster effects (from DARK).
Ryu Senshi is fused from Warrior Dai Grepher and Ryu-Kishin Powered via Polymerization: it negates Normal Traps for 1000 LP and negates targeting Spells.

summary.title: Spells & Utility
points: Chaos Space discards a LIGHT or DARK monster to search an opposite-Attribute boss (BLS Envoy or Chaos Creator), and recycles a banished Grepher to draw 1 card.
Lightray Grepher Special Summons itself by discarding a Level 5+ LIGHT monster, and discards a LIGHT monster to banish a LIGHT monster from your Deck to fuel Chaos summons.
S:P Little Knight and Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos provide versatile banishing, ATK gains, and untargetable protection.

allow.Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Begi: Iconic Chaos Warrior boss effortlessly summoned because Chaos Grepher, Dark Grepher, and Lightray Grepher load the GY with both LIGHT and DARK Warriors.
allow.The Chaos Creator: Level 8 DARK monster (fuels Dark Grepher's hand Special Summon cost!) that banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from GY to summon itself and Special Summons a banished monster (synergizing with Lightray Grepher's deck-banish effect!).
allow.Destrudo the Lost Dragon's Frisson: Level 7 DARK Dragon Tuner that can be discarded from hand to Special Summon Dark Grepher OR dumped from Deck by Dark Grepher/Chaos Grepher, then pays half LP to revive itself from the GY and tune with any Level 4 Grepher into Level 7 Synchros or Level 10 Chaos Angel!
allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Ryu Senshi in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Warrior Dai Grepher directly from your hand or Deck!
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons the Level 4 Normal Monster Warrior Dai Grepher directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dark Grepher, Chaos Grepher, Lightray Grepher, or Warrior Dai Grepher.
allow.Chaos Space: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards a LIGHT or DARK Grepher to search Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning or The Chaos Creator.
allow.Allure of Darkness: Draws 2 cards by banishing a DARK monster from hand.
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Destrudo or a Grepher to the GY.
allow.Polymerization: Fuses Warrior Dai Grepher and Ryu-Kishin Powered into Ryu Senshi.
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro boss that treats any LIGHT or DARK monster (including Level 4 Chaos Grepher or Dark Grepher!) as a Tuner, banishes a card on Summon, and grants both LIGHT and DARK protection.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior from GY.

main: Chaos Grepher
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior (also treated as DARK on the field): discards 1 LIGHT or DARK monster to send 1 LIGHT or DARK monster with the opposite Attribute directly from your Deck to the GY.
Dark Grepher

Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons itself from the hand by discarding 1 Level 5 or higher DARK monster (Destrudo or The Chaos Creator), then discards 1 DARK monster to send any DARK monster from your Deck to the GY.
Lightray Grepher

Level 4 LIGHT Warrior: Special Summons itself from the hand by discarding 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT monster, and discards 1 LIGHT monster to banish 1 LIGHT monster from your Deck (setting up The Chaos Creator!).
Warrior Dai Grepher
Original Level 4 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster (1700 ATK / 1600 DEF) summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai and Fusion Deployment, and named Fusion Material for Ryu Senshi.
Knight Day Grepher
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Gemini that recovers 1 Equip Spell from your GY during the End Phase once Gemini Summoned, and serves as a LIGHT discard for Chaos Grepher and Lightray Grepher.
Ryu-Kishin Powered
Level 4 DARK Fiend Normal Monster (named Fusion Material on Ryu Senshi) that serves as a DARK discard for Dark Grepher and Chaos Grepher.
Destrudo the Lost Dragon's Frisson

Level 7 DARK Dragon Tuner: serves as the Level 5+ DARK discard to Special Summon Dark Grepher from hand (or is dumped from Deck by Chaos/Dark Grepher), then revives itself from the GY to make Synchros!
The Chaos Creator

Level 8 DARK Thunder: serves as a Level 5+ DARK discard for Dark Grepher, then banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from GY to Special Summon itself and Special Summons the LIGHT monster banished by Lightray Grepher!
Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
Level 8 LIGHT Warrior (searchable by Chaos Space; serves as the Level 5+ LIGHT discard for Lightray Grepher!) that banishes 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK from GY to summon itself.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Ryu Senshi in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Warrior Dai Grepher or Ryu-Kishin Powered directly from the Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Warrior Dai Grepher or Ryu-Kishin Powered from the Deck while you control no monsters.
Chaos Space
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends a LIGHT or DARK Grepher from hand to GY to search Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning or The Chaos Creator, then recycles a banished Grepher to draw 1.
Allure of Darkness
Draws 2 cards by banishing a DARK monster from hand.
Polymerization
Fuses Warrior Dai Grepher and Ryu-Kishin Powered into Ryu Senshi.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: dumps Destrudo or a Grepher to the GY.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dark Grepher, Chaos Grepher, or Lightray Grepher.
extra: Signature Level 6 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss ('Warrior Dai Grepher' + 'Ryu-Kishin Powered'; 2000 ATK): negates the activation of any Normal Trap Card for 1000 LP, and negates and destroys any Spell Card that targets it!

Level 10 Synchro boss (easily summoned using Level 4 Chaos Grepher [which is both LIGHT and DARK!] + Level 6 Ryu Senshi or via Destrudo!) that banishes a card on Summon and makes your monsters unaffected by monster effects.
Link-2 FIRE Warrior that boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior from GY.
Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Chaos
Link-3 Warrior boss made using 3 monsters that gains targeting/destruction immunity and banishes cards on battle destruction.
Level 7 Synchro: Quick Effect reduces its Level by 2 to negate and destroy an opponent's Spell or Trap Card.
The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche
Link-3: sends a Phantom Knights monster to GY to set a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap, and pops a card when a DARK Xyz is summoned to its zone.
Link-2: shuffles a banished Machine into the Deck to set an Orcust Spell/Trap directly from the Deck; overlays into Dingirsu.
